text_block_list.text:
I walk into my office one day, only to
find...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My shoe divination and my flower
divination
techniques both told me it
was definitely going to
rain today!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe that divine prophecy
didn't come
true... This is definitely
misfortune at play!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Argh! At this rate, a procession of sumo
wrestlers
is going to stop me from
crossing the street, or a
sudden gust of
wind will have my shrine offerings

sinking to the bottom of a pond!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I do my best to put Матиканэфукукитару
at ease,
but her wild imagination ends
up throwing her out
of sorts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
